app.title: Chrome Omni-Shortcuts Manager
count.heading: Package Count
count.description: Number of shortcut extension packages to generate from the template.
count.label: Count (1–64)
manifestMode.heading: Generation mode
manifestMode.helpOmit: Manifest keys are omitted during generation. This is recommended for this local Chrome profile to avoid unpacked extensions disappearing after restart.
manifestMode.helpInclude: Manifest keys are written into generated packages to pin extension IDs. Every active shortcut key must be valid and unique before generation.
keyAudit.summaryOmitted: Local safe mode: manifest keys are omitted from generated packages. Saved keys are kept in config but not injected into Chrome manifests.
keyAudit.summaryUnavailable: Failed to load manifest key health. Click 'Recheck Key Health' to retry.
keyAudit.summaryHealthy: Manifest keys are healthy: checked {checked}, valid {ok}
keyAudit.summaryIssues: Manifest key issues: checked {checked}, missing {missing}, invalid {invalid}, duplicate IDs {duplicate}
keyAudit.row.omitted: Key injection omitted in local safe mode.
keyAudit.row.missing: Manifest key is empty. ID may drift after restarts.
shortcuts.heading: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Central registry of every shortcut. The URL is baked into the generated package as its default target, and the key pins the Chrome extension ID so Windows and macOS share the same synced storage.
table.label: Label
validate.urlScheme: Only http:// and https:// are allowed.
validate.keyEmpty: No key set — Chrome will assign a per-machine ID.
validate.keyInvalid: Not a valid base64 public key (SPKI). Use the 'New key' button to create one.
validate.keyIsExtensionId: This is an extension ID. The manifest key must be a base64 public key — use the 'New key' button.
confirm.heading: Confirm generation
confirm.autofixKeys:
Auto-fix manifest keys with issues?
Missing/invalid/duplicate keys will be replaced with fresh RSA-2048 keys.
confirm.generate:
Save the configuration and regenerate {count} shortcut package(s)?
Files under extensions/shortcut-* will be overwritten.
confirm.generatePrune:
Save the configuration and regenerate {count} shortcut package(s)?
Files under extensions/shortcut-* will be overwritten, and extra shortcut-N directories will be DELETED (prune is on).
confirm.modeOmit: Current mode: local safe mode. Generated manifests will not contain keys.
confirm.modeInclude: Current mode: fixed ID mode. Key validity and duplicate checks must pass before generation.
status.keyAuditRefreshed: Manifest key health has been refreshed.
status.keyAutofixDone: Auto-fixed {count} problem key(s) and regenerated {generated} extension package(s).
status.invalidImport: Invalid file: expected a JSON object with count and/or shortcuts.
